boundary: The checker independently compares the fixed two-owner client, eight complete normalized post-ElaborateDrops MIR inputs, derived normal and unwind edges, actual Bytes Drop MIR/source, vtable layout, Shared callback/release/free chain, default native AtomicMut shim, AI proof-source prefix, exact terminal helper/caller tokens, and generator mapping fields/hashes. It establishes structural correspondence only for the selected default-std normal-return path. It does not prove MIR/compiler or move/drop-glue correspondence, unwind correctness, arbitrary representations/concurrency, helper contract truth, generic event/cursor/receipt adequacy, or whole-crate verification. Native executions are corroboration; prover semantic controls are archived separately. Toolchain/version, native harness manifest and complete lock package/checksum set, source route, field-profile no-drop const witness, and recorded five-input native execution are now exact source/provenance checks; the generic borrowed-reference no-drop property remains compiler/library TCB. Structural negative controls independently mutate each of the ten explicit support-module #[path] string literals, including the lifecycle and native refcount sources.
